reasoning: The question asks about a Russian crewed aircraft being shot down in NATO airspace by 2026-03-19. The evidence shows multiple incidents of Russian aircraft approaching NATO airspace (January 2026 Be-200 interception, February 2026 Su-30SM2 flights near Baltic borders), but all were intercepted and escorted away without being shot down. The 2015 Turkey incident remains the only historical precedent. With only 13 days remaining until resolution and no evidence of any shootdown in NATO airspace, plus NATO's pattern of intercepting rather than engaging Russian aircraft, this appears unlikely.
